scope: README whole read and memory_profiler.py lines 1-340 read; exact AST functions executed with deterministic seams, not original process sampler

control_result.scope: Exact AST _get_memory and memory_usage; synthetic modern psutil process and timer/pipe only; no process, real sampler or sleep

findings: memory_usage callable branch reruns work when sample count is at most four, reducing interval. One request caused two executions in a deterministic timer seam. Return value belongs to final execution; side effects need not be idempotent.
Callable exception bypasses sampler stop/send, receive and join because invocation lacks finally. Join omission reproduced without starting a process; live orphan duration not measured.

getattr(process, memory_info, process.get_memory_info) eagerly evaluates obsolete default attribute. Modern-interface seam raises AttributeError despite a valid memory_info method. No installed psutil version qualification.

README says OS process memory varies by platform and garbage collection; sampled process RSS is not a complete allocation or peak-memory proof. MiB units used by code should be distinguished from MB label examples.
README declares Simplified BSD. External images and linked issue/benchmark examples were not opened by this text review.

Integer PID with no timeout takes a single sample; Popen/callable branches have different stopping semantics. Callable timeout does not bound target function execution. Static review through line 340 only.
